overall: The AG found the Sewer Commissioners violated the Open Meeting Law by keeping incomplete open-session minutes for Aug 2 and Sept 7, 2010, ordered compliance and minute reconstruction within 30 days, and separately flagged vague notice topics.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the Aug 2 and Sept 7, 2010 open sessions were incomplete, with gaps where the recording secretary was absent and recording stopped.
allegations.key_passage: Where there is a complete gap in the minutes, these requirements cannot be met.

allegations.summary: Not raised by complainant: AG found the 'Superintendent's Report' notice topic for the Aug 2 and Sept 7, 2010 meetings too vague to meet the specificity requirement.
allegations.key_passage: This was not sufficiently specific for purposes of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: AG observed that several topics on the meeting agendas were not listed on the posted notices; it made no finding and only encouraged best practice.
allegations.key_passage: Although a public body may consider a topic that was not listed in the meeting notice if unanticipated, the Attorney General strongly encourages public bodies to postpone discussion and action on topics that are controversial or may be of particular interest to the public if those topics were not listed in the meeting notice.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Create, review, and make public the missing portions of the August 2, 2010 and September 7, 2010 open session minutes, to the best of its ability, within 30 days of receipt of the determination.
remedy_passage: We further order the Board to create, review, and make public the missing portions of the August 2, 2010 and September 7, 2010 open session meeting minutes
